🎬 Breaking News in Yuba County (2021)

Breaking News in Yuba County follows Sue Buttons, a lonely and overlooked woman living in a small California town whose ordinary life takes an unexpected turn when her husband Karl mysteriously disappears. After discovering him having an affair, Sue witnesses a shocking incident that leaves her husband dead, but instead of revealing the truth, she decides to use his disappearance to gain the attention and sympathy she has always wanted. As her story attracts local media coverage, Sue suddenly becomes the center of attention, enjoying her newfound popularity while struggling to maintain her increasingly complicated lies. However, things quickly spiral out of control when a determined police detective, an ambitious television reporter, Karl’s suspicious family members, and dangerous criminals become involved in the investigation. From outrageous misunderstandings and unexpected betrayals to criminal schemes, shocking revelations, and increasingly ridiculous situations, Sue finds herself trapped in a chaotic web of deception. As the consequences of her actions grow more dangerous, everyone involved discovers that the truth is far more complicated than it initially appears. Combining dark humor, crime, suspense, and unpredictable twists, the film explores loneliness, desperation, dishonesty, media obsession, and the dangerous consequences of seeking attention at any cost.

🎭 Genre: Dark Comedy • Crime • Drama • Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 5.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 36m • R

🎥 Director: Tate Taylor
